note: LA.18b/LA.18d. The canonical gorilla chat layout: main.go registers `/ws` with a func-literal that calls serveWs; client.go's serveWs holds `upgrader.Upgrade(`. Plus nhooyr: `mux.HandleFunc("/echo", echo)` where echo calls `websocket.Accept(`. The upgrade marker names no path (generic `ws:ws`); the resolver gives it the paths of the routes whose handler IS its owner function. Baseline 2026-09-18 (HEAD 7a4883b): ws:ws is anchored at the package-level `websocket.Upgrader` var (module CONTAINS, no owner), route:/ws has no HANDLED_BY (func-literal handler), nhooyr has no needle, and the client mints ws_client:ws:// from the concatenation. Only the generic-name coincidence could ever pair /ws.
